reviewer: Kimi actually viewed the exact 65x67 original, independent 528x720 source-note derivative, complete unchanged external-05 raw PNG, native note crop at x=1050,y=1000,width=650,height=250, and full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet. The numerous-dot pattern is replaced by two irregular compact groups in each row, while the viewer-right person, swept-back dark hair, brows, clothing, collar, photographic frame/backplate and small right-edge tab remain. Evidence-page source/output/task/prompt/request/result bindings and the 248-result record verification were checked; this is an experimental art approval pending immutable archival and formal import, not a production or game acceptance claim.

hair_features.reason: Short swept-back dark hair, receding temples, sideburns and distinct dark brows remain; the chin is clean without added beard or glasses.

collar_fit.reason: The dark standing collar and pale diamond-shaped collar tab fit the short broad neck without pinching, floating cloth, a long neck column or a cream bib.

entries.positive_observation: The person faces viewer right toward the note with preserved severe closed-mouth expression, dark swept-back hair, brows, dark gray-green high-collared tunic and pale diamond collar tab. Each of the two note rows now contains TWO irregular source-scale gray-mark groups with appropriate compact relative lengths and spacing, not repeated dots. The lower paper remains blank and the small right-edge tab and complete photographic backing remain.
entries.alpha_decision: The native RGBA is 2048x2048 with extrema 0..254. Counts are 0=1472542, 252=1350472, 253=1123895, 254=38 and 255=0. Full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparisons show genuine exterior transparency around the complete card/frame/note silhouette without visible interior holes, lost backing or a working-matte halo. Internal 252-254 values alone are not rejection grounds.
entries.visible_limitations: The internal collar-tab motif and individual note glyphs cannot be read reliably at 65x67. Approval is for clearly visible group count, irregular shapes, relative lengths, clothing, pose and visible alpha, not guessed text or microscopic details.
